summary: Iteration 3 backend-only testing. Added /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py with 11 new tests covering: (1) TRIAL_DAYS=45 enforced on signup for both iron_man and client (trial_ends_at ~45d from now), (2) GET /api/subscription/plans returns trial_days=45, (3) bill carry-forward across months for partial payments (Dec balance 40 -> Jan carry_in=40, net_due=90, status=unpaid), (4) overpaid carry-forward (-50 credit propagates and reduces next month net_due), (5) multiple payments aggregate into amount_paid/balance with status transitioning unpaid->partial->paid, (6) GET /api/bills/{id}/payments returns payments sorted by paid_at desc, (7) DELETE /api/payments/{id} recomputes bill totals, (8) legacy POST /api/bills/{id}/paid still works (true=>synthetic payment for remaining balance and status=paid; false=>deletes all payments and resets to unpaid), (9) linked client can read bills with all new fields (carry_in/clothes_amount/amount_paid/balance/status) and GET payments read-only, (10) client role gets 403 on POST /api/bills/{id}/payments and DELETE /api/payments/{id}. Also fixed a stale assertion in test_flows.py::TestSubscription::test_plans (was asserting trial_days==7, now 45). Full suite = 39/39 passing (100%).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1053 lines - over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers/{auth,clients,entries,bills,payments,subscription}.py modules.

_compute_status edge case: when net_due<=0 and amount_paid<=0 it returns 'unpaid' (line 547-548). This means a -50 credit bill (overpaid carry) is shown as 'unpaid' even though the customer actually has credit. UI may want to treat negative balance specially. Verified via TestCarryForwardOverpaid - status was implicit, not asserted, but the math (carry_in=-50, net_due=-20, balance=-20) is correct.
MarkPaidReq.paid=true creates a synthetic payment with notes=None even when remaining<=0 (no-op currently). Fine, but consider returning an error or 200 with no-change for clarity.
seed_data_creation: Trial tests use phones 9888777111 (iron_man) and 9888777112 (client) - cleaned up via direct mongo delete before+after to keep signup idempotent. All other tests use TEST_-prefixed clients with random throwaway phones starting with 8, cleaned in finally blocks. Seed users 9999999991/2 are preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v` from /app/backend. All 39 tests idempotent. Iteration 3 introduces payments collection - delete db.payments to start clean. Bill totals (amount_paid/balance/status) are derived from db.payments via _create_payment/delete_payment, so manual mongo edits to bills won't survive next payment write. Note: trial tests do direct db.users.delete_many on phones 9888777111/2 - PyMongo is a hard dep for these tests.
rca_of_issue: N/A - iteration 3 is feature addition, all features verified working as spec'd. Carry-forward math: _ensure_bill computes carry_in from previous month's (net_due - amount_paid). Status: unpaid (paid=0), partial (0<paid<net_due), paid (paid==net_due), overpaid (paid>net_due). Edge: when net_due<=0 and amount_paid<=0, status='unpaid' (could be 'credit' instead but not in scope).
